verdict.rationale: Remote is a global payroll platform. Its docs say payroll data can be pulled out to your own systems, and that every CLI list command exports to CSV/JSON for spreadsheets, so exporting payroll data for analysis has thin first-party support. No evidence names payroll registers or gross-to-net reports; the only named report is a headcount CSV. Missing for 10: documented payroll register report, gross-to-net report generation, payroll-specific report export, independent or hands-on corroboration.
